input.body:
Hi Gareth,

Thank you for invoice NBL-003-INV-14 for the tap works at Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ (our ref R/003). We can't process it yet, for these reasons:

1. The property on the invoice is shown as Flat 4, 28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick, which isn't this job's address.
2. There are no amounts shown (no line costs, VAT or total).
3. There is no date showing when the work was done.

Please could you send a corrected invoice with the right address, an itemised cost and the date of the work.

The job also covered rainwater coming through the bathroom vent during heavy rain and damp patches on the ceiling and wall of the smaller bedroom. Please could you also send us your findings on those: what you saw, the likely cause, and whether it needs a roofer or other trade. If you have a quote for further work, please send that too.

Many thanks,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

Dear Elian,

Thank you for letting the plumber in on Friday 12 September at Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford (ref R/003). He has reported fitting a new kitchen mixer tap and repairing the bathroom basin hot tap. Could you let us know whether both taps have now stopped dripping and whether the hot tap now shuts off properly?

We're also waiting on the contractor's findings about the water coming through the bathroom vent and the damp in the smaller bedroom. In the meantime, if water comes through the vent during rain, please put a towel or container underneath it, keep the room ventilated, and tell us straight away if the damp spreads or water gets near any electrical fittings or lights.

We'll be back in touch by Wednesday 17 September with the next steps.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

Dear Owen,

Here is an update on the repairs at Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford (ref R/003).

- Copper Finch Plumbing attended on 12 September. Their invoice describes a new kitchen mixer tap and a new insert and head on the bathroom basin hot tap.
- We have put the invoice on hold and queried it with them. It shows a different property address (28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick) and no amounts, so we won't send it to you for payment until we have a corrected, itemised version.
- We have also asked the contractor for findings on the water coming through the bathroom vent and the bedroom damp. These are not covered by the invoice.
- We have passed your questions about building insurance cover and the flat's history of roof leaks to a colleague, who will follow them up with you.

We'll update you once the contractor replies. You don't need to do anything at the moment.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

input.summary: R/003, Flat 4, 8-12 Juniper Mews, Vellumford. The tenant (Elian Voss) reported two dripping taps, rain coming through the bathroom vent and bedroom damp. The landlord (Owen Vale) said "Yes, please proceed" on 4 Sept (event 004) and also asked us to check building insurance cover and review the flat's roof-leak history, saying the leaks were repeated and some damage looked severe. Neither request has been actioned (events 005, 012). Copper Finch Plumbing (Gareth Lune) attended on 12 Sept after a confused cancellation and correction (events 014-020). Invoice NBL-003-INV-14 (event 022) covers the taps only. Today I queried the invoice and asked for vent and damp findings with the contractor, asked the tenant to confirm the taps are fixed, updated the landlord, and placed a 3-day hold on the contractor.
input.checked: Read tap-works-invoice.pdf. It gives the property as "Flat 4, 28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick" and shows no prices, total, work date or billed-to name. Event 020: the contractor called the address "8-10 Juniper Mews" on arrival; the tenant corrected it. Event 021: no findings on the vent or damp were recorded. No approval record exists in the CRM. move_stage to works was refused for that reason, so the ticket is still at intake even though the landlord approved by email in event 004. No lessons found.
input.uncertain: Whether the invoice is for this job with a typo or belongs to another property. The cost of the work. Whether the vent or damp were looked at at all. The source of the leak (roof or common parts, so possibly the freeholder or building insurance). Whether the taps are now fixed. Insurance cover.
input.recommendation: Property manager: (1) record the landlord's event-004 approval in the CRM so the stage can move forward; (2) don't forward the invoice until a corrected, itemised version for Juniper Mews arrives; (3) take on the landlord's building insurance question and review the roof-leak history, probably with the freeholder or managing agent; (4) once the contractor's findings are in, arrange a roofer or damp survey with landlord approval.

result.summary: I've put the Copper Finch tap-works invoice on hold. It names a different property (28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick) and has no amounts or work date. I've asked the contractor for a corrected, itemised invoice and for findings on the vent leak and bedroom damp, which the invoice doesn't cover. I've asked the tenant to confirm the taps are fixed and given them containment advice, and updated the landlord. I escalated the landlord's insurance and roof-leak history requests, plus the invoice mismatch, to a human. A 3-day hold is set on the contractor.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved the work by email (event 004), but the invoice (event 022 / attachment) names another property and shows no amount. It can't be forwarded or paid, and the contractor needs to correct it. The vent and damp issues were in scope (event 008) but there are no findings on them (event 021). The landlord's requests about building insurance and roof-leak history (events 004 and 005) were never actioned. Insurance is outside the maintenance remit, and the repeated water ingress needs agency judgement. That calls for a human handover, while the contractor and tenant are asked for what only they can answer.
